status_rule: These are candidate delivery offers, not production commitments. Every composite remains unverified until its next gate passes.

pilots.label: Document/finance-heavy — invoice-to-cash control
pilots.job: Collect invoice/receipt evidence, extract fields, reconcile payments, and prepare approved follow-ups or posting exceptions.
pilots.outcome_metric: Invoice-to-review time, matched rate, exception aging, and close-cycle duration; baseline a 20-item sample first.
pilots.trigger: New approved inbox/drive artifact, payment arrival, aging threshold, or close schedule.
pilots.state: Raw artifact → extracted fields → match/exception → approval.
pilots.decision: Safe match/post/draft versus missing evidence, tolerance breach, duplicate, or finance-owner review.
pilots.side_effect: Stage ledger/queue updates and draft an AR email; send/post/write-off only after named approval.
pilots.authority: Finance data owner approves system-of-record writes, payment/dispute messages, write-offs, and financial commitments.
pilots.verification: Artifact hash/source link, schema/totals/currency/duplicate/tolerance checks, post-write read-back, and send receipt.
pilots.recovery: Quarantine parse failures, preserve snapshots, reopen exceptions, cancel queued sends, retry by idempotency key.
pilots.audit: Append extraction, match, approval, side-effect, verification, and recovery events with actor/version/timestamps.
pilots.source_of_truth: Client-approved ledger/payment system; Actionist queue is derived review state.
pilots.gate_exit: Secure disposable sandbox; run 20 mixed invoices/receipts through extraction, match, exception, approval, and read-back without production posting.

pilots.label: Operations-heavy — request-to-dispatch desk
pilots.job: Capture requests from inbox/form/chat, classify and assign them, update the operational system, and publish a morning exception digest.
pilots.outcome_metric: First-response time, unowned-request count, SLA attainment, and handoff completeness; baseline one queue.
pilots.trigger: New request/message/file, state change, SLA threshold, or morning schedule.
pilots.state: Normalized request → owner/SLA → target write → acknowledgement.
pilots.decision: Complete/duplicate/urgent/authorized browser action versus human review.
pilots.side_effect: Create/update task or work order, send acknowledgement, notify owner, and file supporting documents.
pilots.authority: Operations lead defines allow-listed queues/fields; dispatch, refund, commitment, or sensitive writes require approval.
pilots.verification: Required fields, duplicate key, owner acknowledgement, target read-back, SLA timer, and message receipt.
pilots.recovery: Return to exception queue, preserve original, retry idempotently, cancel wrong assignment where possible, escalate uncertain UI state.
pilots.audit: Source, normalized request, route rationale, browser/session evidence, owner acknowledgement, and final state.
pilots.source_of_truth: Client operations/work-order system; dashboard and digest are derived views.
pilots.gate_exit: Choose one low-risk queue and prove ten synthetic requests through intake, route, write, read-back, and recovery.

pilots.label: CRM/lead-heavy — lead-to-meeting pipeline
pilots.job: Detect/enrich a lead, score it against an approved rubric, draft/respond, book a meeting, and keep the CRM complete.
pilots.outcome_metric: Time-to-first-response, qualified-meeting rate, duplicate-send rate, and CRM completeness; baseline before claiming lift.
pilots.trigger: New portal/form/email lead, stale-lead threshold, trial event, or pre-meeting schedule.
pilots.state: Source event → identity/consent → qualification → approved response/slot → CRM handoff.
pilots.side_effect: Update allow-listed CRM fields, draft/send approved response, create calendar event, and create owner task.
pilots.authority: Sales owner governs messaging/claims and high-value or regulated decisions; CRM writes are allow-listed/reversible.
pilots.recovery: Suppress duplicate sends, preserve lead history, undo staged writes, retry by lead/event key, route ambiguity to human.
pilots.audit: Source, enrichment, score/rationale, draft/approval, CRM diff, calendar event, and handoff acknowledgement.
pilots.source_of_truth: Client CRM for pipeline state; source system owns origin and calendar owns bookings.
pilots.gate_exit: Use sandbox CRM/calendar and synthetic lead feed; prove 20 duplicate-safe, approval-gated, opt-out-safe cases.

first_ten_offers.name: AR chase and reconciliation desk
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: Accounting firms, ecommerce, construction finance teams
first_ten_offers.job: Extract invoice/payment evidence, match records, and prepare approved chase messages plus exceptions.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Invoice-to-review time, matched rate, exception aging, follow-up completion.

first_ten_offers.name: Receipt and expense intake
first_ten_offers.job: Capture receipts, extract fields, identify missing evidence, and stage categorization for review.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Capture completeness, time-to-review, duplicate rate, uncategorized backlog.

first_ten_offers.name: Month-end close control tower
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: Accounting firms, SaaS finance, ecommerce finance
first_ten_offers.job: Run close inputs, reconcile exceptions, alert on variance, and prepare an approval-ready digest.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Close-cycle duration, open exceptions, missing evidence, variance-review latency.
first_ten_offers.trigger: Month-end schedule, checklist state change, or variance threshold.

first_ten_offers.name: Lead response and meeting booking
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: Real estate, insurance, mortgage, SaaS sales teams
first_ten_offers.job: Qualify a lead, draft/route the response, book a slot, and update CRM.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: First-response time, qualified-meeting rate, duplicate-send rate, CRM completeness.

first_ten_offers.name: CRM cleanup and pipeline hygiene
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: SaaS, IT services, marketing agencies, sales teams
first_ten_offers.job: Find duplicates, missing owners/stages/next steps, and stale opportunities; stage safe repairs and a manager digest.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Completeness, duplicate rate, stale count, forecast-exception aging.
first_ten_offers.trigger: Nightly sweep, closed-won event, or manager request.

first_ten_offers.name: Request intake and routing desk
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: Property management, hospitality, construction, IT/MSP, education
first_ten_offers.job: Normalize inbound requests, assign owner/SLA, update tracker, and notify requester.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: First-response time, unowned count, SLA attainment, handoff completeness.

first_ten_offers.name: Exception and SLA monitor
first_ten_offers.job: Watch records, detect exceptions, alert owners with context, and track acknowledgement.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Time-to-detection, acknowledgement, breach rate, duplicate-alert rate, resolution aging.
first_ten_offers.trigger: Schedule, threshold, event/webhook, or state change.

first_ten_offers.name: Meeting-to-tasks and digest
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: SaaS product teams, agencies, course/cohort businesses, consultants
first_ten_offers.job: Extract decisions/actions from a transcript, create owned dated tasks, and deliver a source-linked recap.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Action capture, owner/date completeness, task-creation latency, overdue aging.

first_ten_offers.name: Document filing and renewal tracker
first_ten_offers.buyer_context: Law firms, accounting firms, IT/MSP, property management
first_ten_offers.job: Name/file documents, extract key dates, monitor renewals, and prepare approval-gated reminders.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Filing completeness, retrieval time, missed renewals, reminder lead time.
first_ten_offers.trigger: Document arrival, extracted date, or renewal threshold.

first_ten_offers.name: Weekly KPI and executive brief
first_ten_offers.job: Collect approved metrics, flag anomalies, link sources, and prepare a concise review brief.
first_ten_offers.outcome_metric: Brief production time, freshness/completeness, decision latency, anomaly aging.

offer_delivery_note: All ten offers are plausible from current Actionist operation concepts plus local scaffold/workflow candidates, but none is production-deliverable until its next gate proves target-app access, source-of-truth, permission scope, side-effect verification, and recovery.
